description: The nth Fine number. F(0) is 1, F(1) is 0, F(2) is 1, and F(6) is 57. For n at least 1, F(n) = C(n) - sum of C(i)*F(n-1-i) over i from 0 to n-1, with C the Catalan numbers. n runs from 0 to 80. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fine
